permissions.readOnlyCustomers: Read-only — contact your administrator to request permission to update customers.
permissions.cannotAssignRoles: You don't have permission to assign roles — contact your administrator.

security.title: Security Overview
security.subtitle: Anomalous sign-ins, authentication trends, restricted accounts, and multi-factor coverage across the last {{days}} days.
security.scopeNote: These figures cover only the organizations you administer — they are not platform-wide totals.

tiles.anomalousSome: Flagged and escalated to step-up verification
tiles.tokenReplayNone: No refresh token has been replayed

trend.title: Authentication outcomes
trend.subtitle: All three series share one scale, so their relative size is meaningful.
trend.empty: No authentication activity recorded in this window.

repeat.title: Accounts flagged more than once
repeat.subtitle: One flagged sign-in is usually a new device. Repeats are a pattern worth reviewing.

log.title: Anomalous sign-in log
log.subtitle: Sign-ins that passed the password check but did not match the account's own device or network history, newest first.
log.empty: No anomalous sign-ins in the last {{days}} days. Detection is active — this is a clean window, not a disabled check.

restricted.title: Accounts that cannot sign in
restricted.subtitle: Locked by brute-force protection, or never verified. Both present as "I can't get in".
restricted.empty: Every account is in good standing.

mfa.title: Multi-factor coverage
mfa.subtitle: The single-factor group is exactly the population that falls back to an emailed code when a sign-in is flagged.

servicesAdmin.title: Manage Services
servicesAdmin.subtitle: Add, edit, and retire the offerings available on new invoices. Retired services stay here so they can be brought back — nothing is ever deleted.
servicesAdmin.name: Name
servicesAdmin.emptyHint: Add your first service to make it selectable on new invoices.
servicesAdmin.editNote: Editing a service does not change invoices already raised — they keep the name and price captured at the time.

invoice.numberLocked: The invoice number cannot be changed — it is the reference already printed on the customer's copy.
